## 430. Tasks and what performs them (UE12)

UE, a unified explanation of reality, asks in its fifth item to read constructor theory's tasks as admissions and to test whether widening is the order its possible tasks carry ([plan](../../development/ue-unified-explanation/PLAN.md)). UE10 read the possible on any process ([§424](424.md#424-what-a-course-keeps-reachable-ue10)) and UE11 the possible relative to what is held ([§429](429.md#429-where-the-possible-grows-ue11)). UE12 reads constructor theory's task, what performs it and the possible on any process divided into a performing part and a substrate ([note](../../development/ue12-tasks-and-what-performs-them/NOTE.md)).

**Its standing.** Every law is near-definitional or a witness. The reading is UE10's possible with what a configuration admits read as its substrate with the part in a region, and the composition laws are the concatenation of traces, the two-region laws their instances at the pair region; the interleaving laws lift and project traces; the regress laws are UE11's tower law read on deliveries and on making; the laws of what can be done with the part held are UE11's held laws at the part; and the order laws are UE10's `Reaching.Possible.of_reach` and lagged covering by prefixing. Constructor theory's examples, catalysis, an impossible transpose, equal and opposite amounts, the additive pattern and the pharaonic regress (Deutsch 2013, §2.1, §2.3, §1.2, §3.4, §3.1), become theorems or witnesses. The process-theoretic reading of Gogioso and others (2023) has the possible tasks form a sub-SMC of Rel with the attribute preserved in every outcome; here delivery is existential, and reuse of one constructor, which they leave open, holds for one region in series and in turn. A short search found no published counterexample to the composition principle, and no statement of the laws on what can be done with the part held, or on the order possible tasks carry, for constructor theory.

**The review and the fix round.** The [review](../../development/ue12-tasks-and-what-performs-them/REVIEW-UE12.md), with 43 Lean probe theorems, found every proof of the first draft correct with an empty axiom report and the prose claiming more than the Lean in six places: the reading was called a held part, though the module's own catalytic cycle shows what performs is restored, not held; the composition principle was said to hold within interleavings, which a probe refuted on one substrate; invariable delivery lacked constructor theory's halting; the resetting witness left out an output Deutsch's tasks must list; the tower law is a regress within one delivery, not the pharaonic requirement; and reuse held for one region only. All 22 findings were taken: the framing restored-not-held, possibility read in each process with projections and a failure within one interleaving, the counter and zero-move witnesses, the reach in the invariable form, the listed pair not regular, `PossibleFrom` with `tower_made_held` and `Unmade`, the grammar's `«而»` and `«逆»` for serial composition and the transpose, one part under two regions, the catalysed series showing holding sufficient and not needed, the one-region laws with the two-region laws as instances, the conserved witness's reading named and completed with Deutsch's additive pattern, "region" for a predicate, and `PossibleWithPartHeld` for an idiom.

**The re-check.** An independent [re-check](../../development/ue12-tasks-and-what-performs-them/RECHECK-UE12.md) of the revised module, with 43 probe theorems of its own, found every proof correct with an empty axiom report and every finding of the review taken, and found what the module said still short of the Lean in three places. First, the answer to the plan's question read only widening with a lag: UE10's lagged order, on what a configuration reaches, is same-offset widening, which ranks a delivered output above its input on one witness and below it on another, and covering, which reads infinite runs, ranks nothing on the catalytic cycle, where no configuration starts a course, while the whole possible narrows strictly there; so what deliveries carry is the inclusion of the whole possible, not widening. Second, `tower_made_held` was read as constructor theory's requirement on chains of construction, which is its hypothesis `PossibleFrom`; the theorem is UE11's tower law at the made performer and adds that such a chain constructs only finitely many levels. Third, three sentences dropped a condition: a task relating each input to itself needs each input had, and serial composition with no performing part needs the regular pair, which a new witness shows is needed. All eight findings were taken: the order stated as inclusion, with `Reaching.widensOrLater_iff_of_reach`, the falling witness and the catalytic cycle's silent covering; `tower_reach_held` and `tower_made_held` stated with the performers as found; the conditions restored, with the witness `Unregular`; invariable delivery stated on the grammar's fixed successor `«定后于»`, which the proofs need only where the presented configuration reaches; the conserved amount's one-to-one recoding proved and its four single tasks completed; the counter rebuilt on UE10's climbing process for relational tasks, as `ClimbTask`; `Delivers.narrows`, which states an inclusion, renamed `Delivers.adds_nothing`; and the placement and standing notes in the record. The module has 128 theorems in 167 declarations, every axiom report empty. Each change is taken from the re-check's proposed Lean or text or built from its probes, and no independent reader has read the module since.

**Decisions at landing.** `Reaching.coversLater_of_trace`, `Reaching.not_widensWithLag_of_reach` and `Reaching.widensOrLater_iff_of_reach`, laws of reach and lagged covering on any process, and `Tasks.tower_reach_held`, a law of UE11's tower, stay in the leaf until the owners of UE10's and UE11's definitions move them. `Tasks.interleave`, the package's first asynchronous product of processes, belongs beside `productProcess` at the process layer once another module needs it, and `Tasks.sameReading_class` duplicates `GrammarCourse.sameValue_class` up to orientation, outside the closure; the general fact belongs at the grammar. `Becoming.Rising`, `Becoming.Coupled` and `Becoming.Counting` are taken, so the witnesses are `RiseTask`, `Resetting` and `ClimbTask`.

**Readings** [AI reading, D45]. Constructor theory says what can be done and what cannot, and why. Read on processes, what performs a task is what each delivery restores, not what it holds: a catalyst leaves its form and returns to it. The possible tasks carry reach: from an input to the outputs delivered from it the whole possible never grows, and on the catalytic cycle it narrows for good. Widening what can be reached follows deliveries in neither direction, so it is not the order the possible tasks carry. What grows is what can be done with the performer held, and only across changes of the performer. Composition is had where deliveries hold, or restore, what the others use, which locality gives for deliveries on their own performer and substrate; where a delivery changes what its task does not list, a regular pair of possible tasks can be impossible by any means, and constructor theory's demand that a task list its unavoidable outputs is what excludes it.
